info.title: VDR-Suite Public API v1 — source-verified selected contract subset
info.description: PARTIAL developer reference, source cross-checked against main 8d8dcfbf26d0b6760ad81dc4b2af4fbbd15d55b0 (2026-10-11). Documents original Phase69.F resources plus Human Account lifecycle/CREATE, grant desired-state read/write, Device pairing/approval/credential issuance, Device grant administration, Device/Credential revoke and one-time credential rotation, plus Human Account Credential/Browser Session metadata and item revoke, authorized Recording keyset/folder browse, recording genre facets and EPG now/next cached reads. This is not full current API coverage, complete account/device administration coverage, or installed daemon/VIDAA runtime acceptance.

post.summary: Admit a one-shot TimerIntent for an exact EPG airing
post.description: Device-only, exact backend timers.create authorization. The server independently resolves the EPG event, matches the source-provenanced strong ETag and verifies native identity, backend generation, expiration and independent backend write policy. This API is fail-closed (503) until the durable observation and submit services are installed. 202 means a durable operation was accepted/replayed, not that a native VDR timer exists. It is NOT POST /timer-assignments/{id}; no SearchTimer and no caller-controlled schedule. Never silently retry unknown outcomes.

get.summary: List backend identities visible to the authenticated actor
get.description: Source: api/rest/src/PublicApiRuntime.cpp, parsePublicBackendCollectionQuery()/publicBackendCollectionResponse(), and core/security/include/SecurityHttpGate.h. An authenticated actor is mandatory; visibility is derived from positive permission-grant backend scopes, not a new backends.view permission. role.read-only alone does not contribute scope. Authenticated users with no positive backend scopes receive an empty 200 collection. The exact authentication transport is deployment-dependent and is not expressed here as a single invented HTTP security scheme (see x-vdr-suite-authentication). A query cursor is opaque (currently be1_-prefixed) and bound to the normalized authorization scope. Restart pagination on 409 cursor_expired; never synthesize or parse cursors. Success responses include Cache-Control: no-store and do not include ETag. Other HTTP methods, including HEAD/OPTIONS, return 405 method_not_allowed with Allow: GET.

get.summary: List Channels from explicitly selected and authorized VDR backends
get.description: An authenticated actor must provide 1–16 distinct backendId query members. Each requested source is independently authorized with channels.view@backend; one denial rejects the entire request, before collection evaluation. The order is (backendId ASC, channelId ASC). The opaque ch1_-prefixed cursor binds the normalized backend source set and last item; source-set mismatch returns 409 cursor_expired. A 200 response may be partial: meta.sources gives all requested sources, and unavailable sources are not silently hidden. At least one source must succeed for a 200; all unavailable yields 503 backend_unavailable. The response has Cache-Control: no-store and no collection ETag. No legacy /api/vdr/channels fallback is permitted by this contract. An optional bounded adjacent-channel query (relativeTo+direction+limit=1 with exactly one backendId and no cursor/sort/order) uses enabled nonradio VDR channelNumber ordering with cyclic wrap. Existing ch1_ ID-ordered pages remain unchanged. Unknown current channel or no other eligible TV channel returns 404.

post.summary: Safely admit native Timer CREATE for an existing TimerAssignment
post.description: Protected mutation: authenticated actor and timers.create@backend are checked before existence disclosure. Browser-session CSRF applies where relevant. The backend is selected via query, not JSON. Must supply a canonical strong assignment If-Match plus an opaque Idempotency-Key; body is exactly {} (max 4096 bytes). A successful admission/replay returns 202 with Operation body/ETag/Location; it is NOT proof of successful native VDR Timer creation. No automatic retry after an uncertain result; any deliberate exact replay must retain the same scope, If-Match, key and request fingerprint. Server rechecks authorization/write policy even for replay.

post.summary: Create a Human Account with durable bounded idempotency
post.description: Protected authenticated accounts.create@* operation with Browser Session CSRF when applicable. Closed JSON body loginName/displayName/password; max 4096 bytes. The password is request-only and never returned, persisted in plaintext or used in idempotency fingerprint. Idempotency scope binds actor and caller key plus non-secret fields. Exact replay returns the existing account (201), even if supplied password differs, without resetting credential. Reusing key with different non-secret fields is 409 idempotency_conflict. No automatic grants or admin role assignment.
